Class PlanetClimateSectionBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.planet.PlanetClimateSectionBuilder
public class PlanetClimateSectionBuilder extends Object
Autonomous UI Controller and Section Builder for Atmosphere, Greenhouse Gases, Macroclimate Regimes, Thermal Equator-to-Pole Gradients, and Tri-Map Climate Raster Ingestion.

Extracted from PlanetGeneratorPanel to satisfy the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP). Manages temperature, precipitation, and seasonality sub-blocks with independent procedural seeds and WMS feeds.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
